title: Bootstrap profile
description: What a bootstrap profile requires, permits and defaults to. Named `bootstrapProfile` rather than `executionMode` because a run's execution mode is a separate control-plane field and conflating them is how a genesis decision leaks into run admission (PRD §6).

required.description: Artifacts without which the bootstrap is incomplete. Absence is a failure, not a warning.

optional.description: Artifacts produced when something consumes them. Producing one to satisfy a count is a defect (PRD §6.1).

evidenceLane.description: Depth of Phase B investigation. Evidence must still distinguish confirmed, reproduced, refuted and unknown at every lane (PRD §7 Phase B).

onFailure.description: PRD §18. A failure is never abbreviated to PASS at any level.
